method.question: Run I11 move-set consistency (R8 vs kernel) exhaustively at 4×4 — the L2 audit's remainder T-b. The G3b discharge scoped I11 at 4×4 to a 50,000-state stratified sample (0.05%); L2's own text forbids a sample ('full table as the denominator, never a sample'). Extend compareSmd1 from 50k to the full denominator, report wall time and peak RSS, measure cost before the full sweep, and keep the seeded-defect controls firing at the small rungs.

findings.question: Is I11 move-set consistency at 4×4 exhaustive with zero violations, on the full table as the denominator?
findings.verdict: yes — two readings: 0 / 48,636,330 (SMD1 slice, all artifact-slice records) and 0 / 99,133,036 (every stored WZO2 table entry, ko-active and passes=1 included)
findings.claim: R8 and the kernel agree bit-for-bit on all 17 bits (16 cells + pass) of every legal-move set at 4×4. The slice arm extends compareSmd1 from 50k to every record the SMD1 format can hold (ko=NONE, passes=0; the format's slice header is fixed by design-M1 §4.6, so ko/passes variants cannot be dumped). The table arm covers the literal '99,133,036' the L2 audit quotes by decoding each stored entry's key byte and comparing directly — strictly more states than the slice (slice 48,505,262 + ko-active 2,122,512 + passes1 48,505,262, partition asserted).
findings.measurement: FULL slice: records=48,636,330 mismatches=0 emit=15,252 ms compare=12,610 ms. FULL table: entries=99,133,036 groups=24,318,165 slice=48,505,262 ko_active=2,122,512 passes1=48,505,262 mismatches=0 total=37,518 ms. Runner: exit 0 in 69.5 s, peak RSS 558 MB.

findings.question: Does the SMD1 slice denominator match the table's legal-position set (no silent denominator reduction)?
findings.verdict: yes, with a documented composition difference
findings.claim: The exhaustive SMD1 emission's is_legal filter counts exactly 24,318,165 legal positions (= OEIS A094777(4) = the table's n_groups, row 4x4.S3a PROVEN), so slice records = 24,318,165 × 2 = 48,636,330. The table stores 48,505,262 of those slice states; the 131,068 difference are legal-but-not-root-reachable slice states (G3a: the table is the root-reachable set; the T380 settled-skip non-reachable figure 133,102 is the same phenomenon under a different convention). Neither denominator was reduced to make the check fit — the two arms report their own spaces and both are exhaustive within them.
findings.measurement: slice arm total = 48,636,330 (asserted); table arm slice_entries = 48,505,262; full-table partition slice + ko_active + passes1 = 99,133,036 (asserted in-test).

findings.question: Was the cost measured before the full sweep, and did the projection hold?
findings.verdict: measured first; projection right about feasibility, overshot the emission arm ~22×
findings.claim: A 10× sample (500,000 records/entries) was timed and the projection recorded before the full run: compareSmd1 245 ms/500k → slice compare ≈ 23 s (actual 12.6 s); table-direct 203 ms/500k → full table ≈ 40 s (actual 37.5 s); slice emission 3,529 ms/500k → ≈ 343 s (actual 15.3 s). The emission overshoot is a methodology artifact: the sample's 3.5 s was dominated by the one-time constant legal-filter sweep over all 43,046,721 colex indices, which the record-ratio extrapolation double-counted. The projection's purpose — decide before committing the machine — was served (projected 407 s total vs 1800 s ceiling; actual 69.5 s).
findings.measurement: projection (recorded before the full run): slice_emit≈343 s slice_cmp≈23 s table_direct≈40 s total≈407 s. Actual: 15.3 + 12.6 + 37.5 ≈ 65 s of compute; exit 0 in 69.5 s wall incl. compile.

notes: T473 closes L2 remainder T-b: the one non-exhaustive G3b condition at 4×4 is now exhaustive — 0/48,636,330 slice records (SMD1 dump machinery extended from 50k to the full slice) and 0/99,133,036 stored table entries (new direct table arm covering ko-active and passes=1 states the SMD1 format cannot represent). The brief's '99,133,036' literal is satisfied by the table arm; the slice arm reports its own format-bounded denominator loudly rather than silently reducing anything. Key-byte decode follows the T383 F-7-corrected artifact2 §2.2 contract (kb>>2) with a regression test; the new table-direct instrument is calibrated green at 3×3 (0/49,428) before being trusted at 4×4. No claim status is proposed: 4x4.C1 stays CLAIMED — Track A, the #2 auditor gate and the KO_SENSITIVE-column distrust still stand; this run removes the I11 sample scope limit from its promotion conditions. Evidence: docs/evidence/I11-4x4-EXHAUSTIVE/PROVENANCE.md (committed). The '0 / 50,000 sampled of 99,133,036 (0.05%)' scope limit in accept.md:218 and CLAIMS.md 4x4.C1 (:328) is superseded by these readings and should be re-quoted wherever cited (T-d absorption territory).
